paper: Understanding, Accelerating, and Improving MeanFlow Training
curriculum_equation: beta(dt, s) = 1 - s + lambda * s * (1 - dt)
gap_definition: dt = t - r (t=1 noise convention, z_t=(1-t)x+t*eps)
progress: s = 1 - (i/T)^k, k = 1 (linear; Table 4), i = iteration, T = total planned iterations
lambda_rule: lambda = 1/E_dt[1 - dt] (uniform expected weight at initialization)
application: beta multiplies the ADAPTIVE-WEIGHTED non-boundary u-loss only (App. B Eq. 8/9); 'strictly after the adaptive normalization'; boundary (t=r) v-loss unweighted by beta
source_full_method: accelerated v-learning via p_acc(t) (DTD) or alpha(t) (MinSNR) on the boundary v-loss
b1v2_deviations: baseline objective is Improved MeanFlow (V-parameterisation, h-only cond, 50% r=t) instead of original MeanFlow; adaptive-weight form identical (p=1)
boundary beta fixed to 1 (matches Eq. 9's unweighted boundary; alpha component intentionally excluded)
isolated_component_reference_effect: paper Table 3: '+ Lu weighting' alone improves DiT-B/4 1-NFE FID 11.58 -> 10.98 (combination with MinSNR/DTD gives the headline 3.43 -> 2.87)
